# XingAI

Primary URL: https://xingai.app

XingAI builds focused AI decision systems for everyday work and life. The
product catalog is at https://xingai.app/apps. Live and demo products should be
checked against that catalog. Coming-soon products may have public detail pages
before their target domains are deployed.

Languages: English, Chinese, Korean.

Live or demo products:
- Meal Coach: https://meal.xingai.app
- Cook AI: https://cook.xingai.app
- Wear AI: https://wear.xingai.app
- Travel AI: https://travel.xingai.app
- Invest AI: https://invest.xingai.app/ai-map
- SAT AI: https://sat.xingai.app
- Research AI: https://research.xingai.app
- Learn AI: https://learn.xingai.app
- Performance Sim: https://lab.xingai.app
- T Today: https://t.xingai.app
- Growth Monitor: https://growth.xingai.app

Decision Agent:
- Product page: https://xingai.app/apps/decision-agent
- Official app: https://decision.xingai.app
- Source: https://github.com/xingaiapp/xingai-decision-ai
- Purpose: turn an investment outcome into a structured sample decision brief
  with evidence, risk, alternatives, next actions, and human confirmation.
- Boundary: informational and educational only; no broker connection or
  autonomous trading.
